crossRefs.note: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.
He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.
Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and Yahweh caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all night, and…
With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed…
Who caused his glorious arm to be at Moses’ right hand? Who divided the waters before them, to make himself an…
Was Yahweh displeased with the rivers? Was your anger against the rivers, or your wrath against the sea, that you rode…
You trampled the sea with your horses, churning mighty waters.
You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.
It shall be that when the soles of the feet of the priests who bear the ark of Yahweh, the Lord of all the earth, rest…
You uncovered your bow. You called for your sworn arrows. You split the earth with rivers.

translations.web: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.
translations.bsb: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
translations.kjv: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.
